lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.admin_set_user_role(target_user_id uuid, new_role text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/admin_set_user_role`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.admin_set_user_status(target_user_id uuid, new_status text, reason text)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/admin_set_user_status`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

metadata.name: admin_set_user_status
metadata.arguments: target_user_id uuid, new_status text, reason text

findings.detail: Function `public.is_approved()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/is_approved`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
